title: 9.6.2 | Bugfix Patch
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/41ec07cd9c822173711e53ea949b6d144f512949.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The Pig's Amanda's Letter add-on has been re-enabled.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/XSCJD9OBJTIB/bar-red.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]2v8[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Play buttons were greyed out in the Overview tab after viewing the Quests.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue had missing SFX when Hooking Survivors in Body and Head Form.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nightmare activates the Dream Snare attack and the SFX audio is distorted for the Survivor nearby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Dredge's "Nightfall soon" SFX Volume is louder than usual inside a Locker.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Tomie's audio persist in other trials against The Spirit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Demogorgon's Red Moss add-on did not silence the gurgling SFX when exiting a portal.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Feng Min outfits had clipping issues around the skirt during multiple animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph had a small object sticking from its head during the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the the Survivors' footsteps VFX are missing when above The Xenomorph Tunnel and also an Aura between the Control Station and Exit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Pig's add-ons Amanda's Letter, Jigsaw's Sketch, and Jigsaw's Annotated Plan did not affect the number of RBTs available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Executioner's Obsidian Goblet add-on prevented the perk Spirit Fury to work correctly when using ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Blight did not lose Tokens when breaking a pallet with 3 or less Tokens.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nurse was missing her fatigue animation from Survivor POV.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Freddy Fazbear's Pizza where the camera clips inside assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Midwich Elementary School where the hooks are not accessible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the large stack of cages in The Forgotten Ruins by replacing collision primitives to fix a gap between cages that was blocking projectiles from being thrown through.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the astrology room in The Forgotten Ruins by fixing collisions and repairing a corrupted 3D file to fix a vault point that had extended collision, blocking projectiles from being thrown through at an angle.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Phantom Fear could trigger on a Survivor despite the Killer not being in view.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Nowhere to Hide was unable to reveal Survivors in the dying state.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Leader remained active after the Survivor is Sacrificed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the totem aura was missing from Survivor POV when Hex: No One Escapes Death was active.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Platforms[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue on PC where DualSense PS controller would have incorrect icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on PC where resizing the game could cause a crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue on Switch/Switch 2 where a Steam logo was visible in the Player Stats Access page.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tentative fix to address flashing lights in a trial.[/p][/*][/list]
